answer: Each reputation contribution decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so durable influence requires sustained, reciprocal honest service rather than a burst of activity. EigenTrust centrality propagates only through trusted, reciprocity-weighted links; newly spawned Sybil identities therefore begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot cross consensus thresholds. A beacon of reliable behavior can build trust over time, but accounts named crystal or velvet gain no shortcut.
